_comment: Documented divergences of the PHP engine against the reference pipeline corpus. Fail-closed: a failing case NOT listed here is red; a listed case that now passes is red (stale baseline). All 27 baselined divergences from the corpus adoption are closed: the on_block hook payloads carry the reference log-format reasons with an empty trigger_info, passive-mode dispatches fire the hook inline with a null status_code, the wildcard + credentials CORS configuration is accepted at construction and downgraded at policy resolution like the reference _compute_cors_config, route-level ip_whitelist/ip_blacklist and route country rules are enforced by the ip_security check (RouteConfig gained the ipWhitelist/ipBlacklist/blockedCountries/whitelistCountries fields), and CORS responses compose the full methods/headers/max-age surface. The baseline is kept as an empty fail-closed registry.
